profile.name: Serco Group plc
profile.summary: Serco Group plc provides public services in the United Kingdom, Europe, North America, the Asia Pacific, and the Middle East. It offers service design and advisory, resourcing, programme management, systems integration, case management, engineering, and assets and facilities management services. The company also provides administrative and back office, asylum seeker accommodation or passenger transport services; and supports in the decarbonization journeys of customers. It serves the United Kingdom and Canadian governments, devolved authorities, and other public sector customers; and federal and civilian agencies, and various state and municipal governments in citizen services, defense, health and other facilities management, justice and immigration, and transport sectors. Serco Group plc was founded in 1929 and is based in Hook, the United Kingdom.
profile.summary_fr: Serco Group plc fournit des services publics au Royaume-Uni, en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Asie-Pacifique et au Moyen-Orient. Il offre des services de conception et de conseil, de ressources, de gestion de programmes, d'intégration de systèmes, de gestion de cas, d'ingénierie et de gestion d'actifs et d'installations. La société fournit également des services administratifs et administratifs, des services d'hébergement des demandeurs d'asile ou de transport de passagers; et soutient les voyages de décarbonisation des clients.
